quote: Beloved Pan, and all ye other gods who haunt this place, give me beauty in the inward soul; and may the outward and inward man be at one.
source: Plato, Phaedrus, 279b to 279c, the closing prayer (Socrates) (trans. Benjamin Jowett, 1892)
speaker: Socrates
